# ⚠️ DO NOT EDIT — GENERATED DIRECTORY

Files in `src/data/` are **automatically synced** from `festivals/sziget-2026/data/` (the default festival) by `scripts/sync-data.mjs`.

**Source of truth:** `festivals/<festival-id>/data/`  
**Runtime-served data:** `public/data/<festival-id>/`

To update lineup or POI data, edit the files in `festivals/<id>/data/` and then run:
```bash
npm run lineup:sync
```
or simply restart the dev server (sync runs automatically on `predev`).
